note: Free designated dispersed camping area on South Mineral Creek, 2.6 mi up FR 585 (South Mineral Rd / CR 7) from US 550, 2 mi north of Silverton, ~9,600 ft. A large open dirt area with pockets into the trees and vault toilets; no numbered sites. The good gravel road is 2WD as far as the Ice Lakes trailhead (4.4 mi). Camping only in the designated areas along FR 585 and at least 100 ft from the creek; extremely busy in July-August. --Claude
summary: No FS page of its own. FS pages confirm FR 585 camping is designated-areas-only, 2WD road to the Ice Lakes trailhead, 14-day forest limit; the San Juan Mountains Association names Golden Horn as one of four FR 585 camping areas with outhouses. Facilities confirmed (vault toilets, no water); booking first-come, 14-night limit. INCLUSION flag: the FS's own list of designated areas names only Anvil, Bear and Sultan, not Golden Horn, and there are no numbered sites. Website is the forest's generic camping page.
flags: INCLUSION: no Forest Service page for Golden Horn exists. The FS's South Mineral Campground page says 'Dispersed camping along Forest Rd. 585 is allowed only in designated camping areas which include Anvil, Bear and Sultan Camping Areas' - Golden Horn is not named (the list says 'include', so it may not be exhaustive). The FS conditions page: 'South Mineral Creek allow[s] camping in designated sites only ... no motor vehicles are allowed off South Mineral Road (FDR 585) or Clear Creek Road (FDR 815) to access camping sites.' The San Juan Mountains Association (FS partner) lists 'Golden Horn on the left at 2.6 miles' among '4 camping areas with outhouses in the first 2.6 miles of FS 585'. No site count or numbered sites anywhere: it is one large open dirt area (imagery shows ~10 rigs parked around a gravel circle) with tree pockets. A designated AREA with toilets, not numbered designated sites - human decision.

Access: no 4WD or high-clearance wording for this stretch. FS: FR 585 'parallels South Mineral Creek ... and is drivable by 2WD. Just past the [South Mineral] campground, the road becomes 4WD' (Golden Horn is ~1.8 mi before that). SJMA: 'Follow the good gravel road ... This road is suitable for two-wheel drive vehicles.' Not plowed in winter; FR 585 season on the conditions table 5/1-11/30, weather dependent.

Website is the generic San Juan 'camping-cabins' page; no page of its own exists. The closest agency pages are https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/sanjuan/recreation/south-mineral-campground (names the FR 585 designated-area rule) or https://sjma.org/ice-lake-trip-planning/.
Missing phone: Columbine Ranger District (970) 884-2512 (San Juan FS pages); the Silverton public lands office is seasonal.

Waterfront (stored creekside): the open camping area's south-east edge runs along South Mineral Creek (braided, ~15-25 m wide), ~40-60 m from the pin. But the FS rule is 'Do not camp within 100 ft of any water source', and a 2025-08-21 camper reports 'The access to additional more private riverside spots was cut off with giant wooden X's'. Re-audit lead: on-creek camping appears closed off, which may undo the creekside value. Not changed.
Fees: no agency page states a fee or that it is free (stored $0 rests on listings; FS dispersed camping is normally free). Left alone.
Rig fit: camper reviews describe travel trailers and 'four big motorhomes' in the open area (2017), 'treed spots for 3 trailers' (2021-08-18); no dated 2023+ review naming a 23-ft+ own rig.
